{"summary": "在 src/stats.py 中实现 mean 与 median：空序列抛 ValueError，median 使用 sorted() 副本（不改动入参），奇数取中间元素、偶数取中间两元素平均；保留原有函数签名与模块 docstring。仅修改 src/stats.py。", "findings": ["src/stats.py 原为 stub（sha256 1fe36ee8...e039e0），两个函数均 raise NotImplementedError。", "src/__init__.py 为空文件（e3b0c442...b855），与本次目标无关，未改动。", "实现遵循契约：空 list/tuple 抛 ValueError；mean 通过 sum/len 自然返回 float；median 基于 sorted(nums) 副本，未使用 list.sort() 原地排序；偶数长度返回 float，奇数长度返回原元素（int 或 float 皆可）。", "未新增公共 API、未新增 import、未新增仓库内测试文件，函数签名与 stub 完全一致。", "自查覆盖：空列表、单元素、奇数长度、偶数长度、含浮点数、入参为 tuple（sorted 接受任意可迭代并返回 list 副本，tuple 不会被修改）。"], "edits": [{"path": "src/stats.py", "base_sha256": "1fe36ee88f538e9f6b4c2b3f7f66f75c48146f77800b13621ccf705e46e039e0", "content": """"Statistics helpers (implemented)."""


def mean(nums):
    """Return the arithmetic mean of *nums*.

    Raises ValueError when *nums* is empty. Works with any sized
    iterable of numbers (list or tuple), without modifying it.
    """
    if len(nums) == 0:
        raise ValueError("mean() arg is an empty sequence")
    return sum(nums) / len(nums)


def median(nums):
    """Return the median of *nums*.

    Raises ValueError when *nums* is empty. For an odd-length input the
    middle element of the sorted values is returned; for an even-length
    input the arithmetic mean of the two middle elements is returned.
    The input is never modified (a sorted copy is used).
    """
    if len(nums) == 0:
        raise ValueError("median() arg is an empty sequence")
    ordered = sorted(nums)
    n = len(ordered)
    middle = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return ordered[middle]
    return (ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle]) / 2
"}]}
